text: Meet Open Code see eye. It runs your coding agent in your pipeline, with the workflow you already use.
It can sign in with your Chat GPT Plus or Pro subscription through OAuth. Give C I a dedicated login. When tokens refresh, the updated credentials are saved for the next run.

Then the agent hands work to two subagents. One checks tests while the other checks security. Their steps and replies show up with a label for each child agent, so you can follow the work even when it overlaps.
Your project commands work here too. Call slash review, or load an installed skill explicitly with the skill flag. Humanizer, for example. If a required skill is missing, the run fails.
There's a full pull request review example in the project if you want to try it. Pick a job and let it run.
